source: 搜神记 第一卷 第二章 谪仙人 / 真相将成，静压将破
purpose: Seed for EP02 SC33 after EP02 SC32 formal test-mode segment. Continue the ComfyUI short-drama pipeline from the point where truth and restraint are nearly past recovery into the next threshold: Keshadu's certainty is almost irrevocable, Shisilang's fury is close to true rupture, Tuobaye is nearly empty of reserve, and the white-clothed woman's restraint feels one turn away from unmistakable release.
title: 真相将成，静压将破

continuity_from.approval_mode: Codex auto-pass test mode with user authorization
continuity_from.caveat: SC32 is approved only for pipeline validation. All four SC32 videos used Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback because stable reference-driven I2V is not currently available through Gemini and Runway secret is missing.

source_grounding.anchor_after: 真相将实，十四郎怒线将断，拓拔野几近枯竭，白衣女子的静压已到将裂边缘。
source_grounding.adapted_summary: 下一段要把这根压到极限的线继续推进到几乎真正破裂。科沙度的判断已经逼近既成事实，十四郎的失控会让局面更容易断裂，拓拔野也几乎只剩最后一点本能硬撑。白衣女子的克制则到了几乎无法再维持外观完整的地步。
source_grounding.next_source_hint: 下一段应把隐线从将裂推进到真正破面的门前，为后面的明确出手或彻底揭露做直接铺垫。

continuity_rules: Adult-adapted Tuobaye only: age 28 to 32, rugged grey-brown rough cloth layers, rope belt, travel pouch, green bamboo flute, right-waist green bamboo sheath, hidden broken Wufeng.
White-clothed woman remains elegant and restrained until the real source beat forces the visible break; avoid fake spectacle before the true turn.
Keshadu should now feel functionally certain to the point of near-public fact.
Shisilang remains unstable and close to real rupture.
No readable text, captions, subtitles, plaques, gate calligraphy, speech bubbles, English words, or UI.

generation_policy.orchestration: ComfyUI only; cloud APIs must be called through Comfy workflow nodes.
generation_policy.gemini_video_mode: Do not use experimental file_ids I2V unless the Gemini-API contract probe confirms it is supported again.
generation_policy.runway_video_mode: Use Runway I2V only if RUNWAYML_API_SECRET is available; otherwise use Comfy StillFrameVideoFallback for pipeline continuity and mark it clearly.
generation_policy.review_gate: Test-mode auto-pass may be used while operator is absent, but record it clearly and preserve known quality issues.
generation_policy.secret_hygiene: Use api_key_env_path or local key indirection; do not inject plaintext keys into Comfy prompt JSON/history.
generation_policy.motion_safety: Keep the beat readable: fact-forming truth, rupture-edge fury, near-empty endurance, and fracturing restraint should appear as separate visual steps.
